FENCE FALSIFIER FOUND A REAL HOLE IN THE FENCE: case F3 ({signatures_playable: 486}) walked straight through, because `_` is a word character so \bplayable\b never matches inside a snake_case key -- and every key in the artifact is snake_case. Fixed by normalising `_` before the scan. Rule 4 paid for itself on its first run.

The renamed screen is 4 rules: vocabulary (claim words, on artifact + stdout + stderr), shape (row verdict is a 3-value string, never a boolean; forbidden keys incl. `target`), exit (0 only when nothing condemned and nothing abstained), and one enumerable exemption for the pointer literal `tools/quests/viability-walk.mjs`.

WALK LANDED, 40 signatures, all four arms at a5a637d (box: 18-24 headless_shell, loadavg 10-15 throughout; ~35s per 40-signature arm):
ARM granted-nothing:  5/29 main-quest quests, 0/40 finished main, 0/40 three-at-rank-5, 0 violent, 200 free endings, gold 0->0. ALL 40 stop at Q-MAIN-06.
ARM no-bootstrap:     0 quests, stops at Q-MAIN-01 'the topic "the drowned tally" has not come up yet'. The instrument is sensitive to the one world action it declares.
ARM hand-feed:        IDENTICAL to baseline (5 quests, same stop). The world's own AddTopic edges carry the chain as far as it goes; topics are not what blocks it.

ARM grant-everything: three-at-rank-5 goes 0/40 -> 40/40 while the main quest does not move. THAT IS THE SIZE OF THE FICTION, MEASURED: the criterion the screen abstains on for all 540 signatures is bought outright by grants, and the grants buy nothing else.

BUILD FINDING (played, not modelled): all 40 sampled characters stop at Q-MAIN-06. Both non-violent resolutions (res_the_number, res_the_fair_copy) refuse with 'you do not know rev_the_curve_predates'. QuestEngine.reveal() is the ONLY writer of a know: flag and its only non-harness caller is a hooks.json quest+reveal row -- of which this tree ships 0 of 18. So no play on this tree can produce that reveal. Same shape as NEXT-DISPATCH SS 0c (books teach nothing).

TWO SILENT NO-OPS FOUND IN MY OWN FIRST WALK, both by running it: H.questDef() returns a curated view with no deceit/journal/resolutions, so the reveal loop, the journal-note loop and the free-ending detector all iterated undefined. free_endings printed 0 -- a VACUOUS ZERO. Fixed: requirements now come from the shipped book on the Node side and the true count is 200 of 200 resolutions taken demanding nothing.

questReveal and questNote are now DENIED verbs, not allowed ones, because reveal() has no world-side caller at all. The walk therefore UNDER-CLAIMS and says so in three declared clauses on every artifact -- the opposite direction of error from the screen, and the safe one.
